name: coda-studio
description: Coda Studio — an original spectral-chord composition studio created as an unofficial tribute to Ryuichi Sakamoto: a notation-free spectral chord sequencer (chord-symbol rows x 16 steps, 4-level spectral intensity per cell, a moving vertical playhead plays the piece), real-time spectrum display, piano keyboard, chord pads, reverb/delay, and WAV export. All sound is real-time Web Audio synthesis; zero dependencies, single self-contained HTML, fully offline
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
